The Amitsur-coherent Čech witness exists (ζ2·i, the (C1) étale-separatedness campaign): any witness cochain θ₀ for ζ1's class equality q₁*N = q₂*N over Spec(B ⊗[A] B) is corrected by a single global unit into an Amitsur-coherent one. The defect of θ₀ glues to a global unit of the triple tensor (exists_glued_defect); the comparison p₂^♯θ₀ · (u₂^♯α / u₁^♯α) against the upstairs witness of the lift glues on the curve product and descends through the projection to the correcting unit χ (exists_comparison_unit, via the abstract two-relation ratio compatibility unitsAppLE_coboundary_ratio_compat); the glued defect is the Amitsur coboundary of χ, checked after p₃-pullback where the upstairs telescope cancels exactly (glued_defect_eq_amitsur_coboundary); and θ₀/χ is the coherent witness (CoherentCechWitness structure + nonempty_of_defect_eq_coboundary, headline Over.exists_coherentCechWitness). Proof terms engineered for kernel replay: opaque cover/cochain definitions (amitsurCover, comparisonCover, defectCochain, comparisonCochain, stepGCover) and an abstract-schemes pullback calculus (UnitsGlobalPullback) reduce every concrete step to a single application — the monolithic ancestor died in kernel deterministic timeouts. The composite descent unit of the (C1) assembly exists (ζ2·ii, the pi-assembly): from an Amitsur-coherent Čech witness θ' for q₁*N = q₂*N and a trivializing basic refinement P of N, the corrected witness values — γ-values anchored at the refinement points times the inverted witness, the unique orientation whose coboundary cancels against θ'.witness — glue over each basic open D((rᵢ⊗1)(1⊗rⱼ)) of Spec(B ⊗[A] B) to unit sections (witnessBasicSection) which, transported through the two-base localization identifications (isLocalization_away_tensor generalized to distinct bases, pairAwayEquiv/tripleAwayEquiv) and assembled through the pairwise decomposition (piAssemblyUnit), form an A-descent cocycle on ∏ Γ(Spec B, D(rᵢ)) (isDescentCocycle_assemblyUnit): the triple-product cocycle identity is the Amitsur coherence of θ', with correction factors telescoping in pairs. Its collapse along A → Γ(Spec B,⊤) → ∏ is the Zariski cover cocycle of N (tensorCollapse_assemblyUnit) — on the diagonal the corrections telescope to γ at the anchor points, and Amitsur coherence pulled through the degeneracy Spec(μ₁₂) and the diagonal kills the residual witness value — so descent-in-stages gives the class equation Pic.mapAlgebra A Γ(Spec B,⊤) (picClass v) = pic N (mapAlgebra_picClass_assemblyUnit), the ζ3 hand-off.
